newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Pegasus IPO seen 25 times subscribed--sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Pegasus IPO seen 25 times subscribed--sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in sports shoes manufacturer Pegasus Holdings Ltd is expected to be 25 times subscribed at the close of the public offer on Friday, market sources said.
The company is expected to release the subscription results on October 8 and dealing in shares is expected to begin on October 11.
Yuanta Securities (Hong Kong) Co Ltd is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
Pegasus offered 180.3 million new shares, or 25 percent of the expanded share capital, at HK$1.08 per share.
It said the proceeds raised would be used mainly to expand its production facility in China, to repay bank borrowing and for working capital.
